name: Fuzzy Projection Ranking (FPR)
aliases: FPR (Fast Point Cloud Filtering by Rank)
definition: A point cloud processing technique that projects 3D LiDAR points onto a 2D range image grid based on angular coordinates, then computes a fuzzy rank for each point based on the intensity distribution of its neighbors in the grid to filter noise and enhance features.
summary: Fuzzy Projection Ranking is a point cloud technique that projects 3D LiDAR data onto a 2D grid to compute fuzzy ranks based on neighbor intensity, distinguishing itself by leveraging structured 2D projection for robust denoising.
